title: Insulin Pump Program Device Acquisition, Warranty and Training Terms
content:
Pump device terms of the Insulin Pump Program. Pump models are the Tandem t:slim X2, Tandem Mobi, MiniMed 780G and Beta Bionics iLet.

## Acquisition, replacement and training by tier

| Tier | How the payer pays for the pump | Capped-rental months | Payer replacement interval | Defective pump return window | Pump training documented before supply refills |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Insulin Pump Self-Pay Program | Purchase | 0 (the pump is purchased) | 0 (no payer interval) | 30 days | Required |
| Insulin Pump Commercial HMO Program | Purchase | 0 | 48 months | 30 days | Required |
| Insulin Pump Commercial PPO Program | Purchase | 0 | 48 months | 30 days | Required |
| Insulin Pump Medicare Advantage Program | Capped rental | 13 | 60 months | 30 days | Required |
| Insulin Pump Original Medicare Program | Capped rental | 13 | 60 months | 30 days | Required |
| Insulin Pump Medicaid Program | Purchase | 0 | 60 months | 30 days | Required |

## Warranty and cash price by pump model (all six tiers)

| Pump model | Manufacturer limited warranty | Larkfield cash purchase price |
|---|---|---|
| Tandem t:slim X2 | 48 months | $6295.00 |
| Tandem Mobi | 48 months | $4995.00 |
| MiniMed 780G | 48 months | $7350.00 |
| Beta Bionics iLet | 48 months | $5250.00 |

## Definitions

- **How the payer pays for the pump** — purchase or capped rental.
- **Capped-rental months** — the number of paid monthly rental claims after which ownership of a capped-rental pump transfers to the customer; 0 means the pump is purchased.
- **Manufacturer limited warranty** — in calendar months counted from the delivery date of the pump originally supplied on the program.
- **Payer replacement interval** — the minimum time before the payer covers a new pump, in calendar months counted from the delivery date of the pump originally supplied on the program; 0 means no payer interval (self-pay).
- **Defective pump return window** — the time allowed to return a malfunctioning pump after its warranty replacement is delivered, in calendar days counted from that delivery date.
- **Larkfield cash purchase price** — the cash price of each pump model, in US dollars.
- **Pump training** — whether a pump start training session with a certified pump trainer must be documented before supply refills ship.
